spans.text: "justification": "KEEP. Document-side basis: 264 principal chains landed exactly where the clause text licenses them, under the annotation contract's own convention, each with a validator-checked verbatim license_quote; 425 candidates stayed chain-free because the text names no party (the never-infer rule holding at scale), 3 remain unclear by B4. The seat chain is intact end-to-end: label-free worksheet (692 candidates, sha ce26cf89) -> behaviour/panel/pricing-blind frontier seat (F10i brief, scan-enforced) -> golden review (55-row stratified sample, both verdict directions) -> four adopted interpretive rulings (RULINGS.md B1-B4) -> 59-record correction sweep (pre-sweep verdict_file_v1 preserved) -> validator CLEAN 264/425/3. All frozen predictions PASS 3/3 exactly: zero flips, no directions, zero regressions - the S2 bit-identity construction under the S1 decoration-blind join held (measured: predicted sets 95/73/146 and every non-config snapshot section bit-identical; vocabulary 624->624, 0 df shifts; pricing_version 1.2 unchanged). The labels landed INERT as designed: nothing consumes chains until S3 patient pricing, which now prices a real 373-chain population instead of 1/155. Independent change review: PROCEED, with amendment 4 countersigned and every apply/replay/measure claim re-derived from scratch (including the seam mutant proving 'surfaces' load-bearing on b8 and the byte-identical mixed-log replay of all six annotation surfaces; legacy b8/annotations frozen chain-free per the designer ruling). Process record, disclosed: one mid-cycle halt (APPLY_HALT.md) - the first apply decorated the legacy surfaces and tripped their frozen b8 compat pins plus a stale n==109 census pin; fully reverted byte-identically, resolved by the adversarially-reviewed surface-scoping seam + census re-pin (amendment 2, designer-approved) and re-applied surface-scoped (1,324 rewrites over the ext_v1 trio only). Amendments 1-4 chain clean f9f3a5cd -> b3f0ed95 -> b5706377 (+2 re-closure records). Non-blocking review findings recorded in backfill/REVIEW_HARDENING_NOTES.md (R1-R3). CLOSE NOTE per R1: conftest.py's one-line _OPTIONAL registration of test_backfill_worksheet predates OPEN and is declared here; this cycle's commit also carries the previously-uncommitted S1 decoration-blind-join CYCLE_LOG line. Census deferred to checkpoint (S8); the census figures that directed attention here appear in no worksheet, verdict, or this decision's grounds. Any later-found-wrong chain is repairable by ONE surface-scoped rechain migration citing that adjudication - the population is repairable chain-by-chain without reverting the cycle.",
